# StainSolver

> Stain-removal first moves tailored to the stain, the fabric and how old the stain is, with practical steps and source-backed safety guidance.

Guidance is conservative: always spot-test hidden areas first and follow the garment care label.

## Start here

- [Stain Solver | Stain removal by fabric and spill](https://stainsolver.shop/): Spilled coffee, wine or grease? Get a stain-removal first move tailored to your fabric. Three quick choices, practical steps, and source-backed safety guidance.
- [Our method and sources | Stain Solver](https://stainsolver.shop/about/): How Stain Solver turns public cleaning and textile-care resources into conservative fabric-aware first steps, with safety rules and references.
- [Stain removal guides | Stain Solver](https://stainsolver.shop/guides/): Care-aware guides for common spills on cotton, denim, sofas, carpet, wool, silk and more. Browse by stain and material.
- [Privacy and offline use | Stain Solver](https://stainsolver.shop/privacy/): Stain Solver is free and accountless. Your saved stain plans live in your browser; there are no analytics trackers or external user accounts.

## Stain guides

- [Blood stains on synthetic carpet | Stain Solver](https://stainsolver.shop/guides/blood-on-carpet/): Blood on synthetic carpet? Check that the carpet is synthetic and colourfast. Find the first move, precautions for the backing and signs to stop.
- [Blood stains on coloured cotton | Stain Solver](https://stainsolver.shop/guides/blood-on-coloured-cotton/): Blood on coloured cotton? Use the colour-care checks to decide what your garment can tolerate. Follow the steps and learn when to stop.
- [Blood stains on white cotton | Stain Solver](https://stainsolver.shop/guides/blood-on-white-cotton/): Blood on white cotton? Check the garment label, follow the steps for washable white cotton and see which mistakes can set the stain.
- [How to get oil stains out of clothes | Stain Solver](https://stainsolver.shop/guides/oil-on-clothes/): Cooking oil or grease on clothes? Absorb it with baking soda, break it down with clear dish liquid, then wash warm and check before drying.
- [How to get blood out of jeans | Stain Solver](https://stainsolver.shop/guides/blood-on-jeans/): Blood on jeans? Rinse it from the back with cold water, use an enzyme pre-treatment, and wash cold. Why peroxide can lighten dark denim.
- [How to get foundation out of clothes | Stain Solver](https://stainsolver.shop/guides/foundation-on-clothes/): Foundation on a collar or shirt? Lift the excess, break down the oil with clear dish liquid, treat any colour left, then wash. Steps by formula.
- [How to get ketchup out of clothes | Stain Solver](https://stainsolver.shop/guides/ketchup-on-clothes/): Ketchup on clothes? Scrape it, flush it with cold water from the back, pre-treat, then use oxygen bleach where the label allows. Never use heat first.
- [How to remove water stains from fabric | Stain Solver](https://stainsolver.shop/guides/water-stains-on-fabric/): Water rings on a sofa or fabric? Why they form, how to blend them out with distilled water and fast drying, and when the cleaning code says no water.
- [How to get hair dye out of carpet | Stain Solver](https://stainsolver.shop/guides/hair-dye-on-carpet/): Hair dye on carpet? Blot immediately, use a dish liquid and vinegar solution after a hidden test, then alcohol for synthetics. When to call a pro.
- [How to get cat pee out of a couch | Stain Solver](https://stainsolver.shop/guides/cat-pee-on-couch/): Cat urine on a couch? Check the cleaning code, blot, then use a pet urine enzyme cleaner deep enough to reach it. Why ammonia makes cats return.
- [How to get highlighter out of clothes | Stain Solver](https://stainsolver.shop/guides/highlighter-on-clothes/): Highlighter on clothes? Dab it with rubbing alcohol from the back onto a paper towel after a hidden test, then pre-treat and wash. Step by step.
- [How to get urine smell out of a mattress | Stain Solver](https://stainsolver.shop/guides/urine-on-mattress/): Urine on a mattress? Blot it, treat it with an enzyme cleaner, absorb the odour with baking soda and dry it fully. Low-moisture steps that work.
- [How to get tree sap out of clothes | Stain Solver](https://stainsolver.shop/guides/tree-sap-on-clothes/): Tree sap on clothes? Harden and scrape it, dissolve the rest with rubbing alcohol after a hidden test, then pre-treat and wash. Careful steps.
- [How to get candle wax out of clothes | Stain Solver](https://stainsolver.shop/guides/wax-on-clothes/): Candle wax on clothes? Harden it, scrape off the bulk, lift the rest between paper with a low iron if the label allows, then treat any dye mark.
- [How to get super glue off clothes | Stain Solver](https://stainsolver.shop/guides/super-glue-on-clothes/): Super glue on clothes? Let it set, scrape the bulk, then dissolve the rest with acetone after a hidden test. Which fabrics acetone damages.
- [How to get crayon out of clothes | Stain Solver](https://stainsolver.shop/guides/crayon-on-clothes/): Crayon on clothes, or melted crayon from the dryer? Scrape the wax, lift the rest with paper and low heat if allowed, then pre-treat the colour.
- [How to get mustard and turmeric stains out of clothes | Stain Solver](https://stainsolver.shop/guides/mustard-on-clothes/): Mustard or turmeric stains? Both get their colour from turmeric, a strong dye. Rinse cold, pre-treat, use oxygen bleach where allowed, and be patient.
- [How to remove mold and mildew from clothes | Stain Solver](https://stainsolver.shop/guides/mold-on-clothes/): Mould or mildew on clothes? Brush spores off outdoors, wash at the hottest temperature the label allows, use the right bleach for the fabric, and dry fully.
- [How to get nail polish out of clothes | Stain Solver](https://stainsolver.shop/guides/nail-polish-on-clothes/): Nail polish on clothes? Blot, don't rub, then dab remover from the back after a hidden test. Why acetone ruins some fabrics, and when to stop.
- [How to get slime out of clothes | Stain Solver](https://stainsolver.shop/guides/slime-on-clothes/): Slime stuck in clothes? Pick off the bulk, loosen the rest with white vinegar after a test, then pre-treat any colour. Steps that avoid spreading it.
- [How to get Sharpie out of clothes | Stain Solver](https://stainsolver.shop/guides/sharpie-on-clothes/): Permanent marker on clothes? Blot it with rubbing alcohol from the back onto a towel, after a hidden test, then wash. Careful steps and limits.
- [How to get coffee out of carpet | Stain Solver](https://stainsolver.shop/guides/coffee-on-carpet/): Spilled coffee on carpet? Blot fast, treat with a mild detergent solution, and rinse without over-wetting. Steps for black coffee and coffee with milk.
- [How to get lipstick out of clothes | Stain Solver](https://stainsolver.shop/guides/lipstick-on-clothes/): Lipstick on a collar or shirt? Lift the wax, break down the oil with detergent or dish liquid, then wash. Steps for regular and long-wear lipstick.
- [How to get dog pee out of carpet | Stain Solver](https://stainsolver.shop/guides/dog-pee-on-carpet/): Dog urine on carpet? Soak it up, rinse, then use an enzyme cleaner made for pet urine so the smell doesn’t bring your dog back. Steps and what to avoid.
- [How to get hair dye out of clothes | Stain Solver](https://stainsolver.shop/guides/hair-dye-on-clothes/): Hair dye on a shirt or towel? Rinse it cold straight away, pre-treat with detergent, and test rubbing alcohol on set marks. Why speed matters.
- [How to remove rust stains from clothes | Stain Solver](https://stainsolver.shop/guides/rust-on-clothes/): Rust marks on clothes? Never use chlorine bleach, which can set them. Use a fabric-safe rust remover or a mild acid after a test, then rinse well.
- [How to get vomit out of carpet | Stain Solver](https://stainsolver.shop/guides/vomit-on-carpet/): Vomit on carpet? Wear gloves, lift solids, absorb with baking soda, then clean with an enzyme cleaner and dry fully. Hygiene steps for illness too.

- [How to get blood out of a mattress | Stain Solver](https://stainsolver.shop/guides/blood-on-mattress/): Blood on a mattress? Use cold water sparingly, blot rather than soak, and dry it fully to avoid mould. Careful steps for fresh and dried stains.
